rule_title: TTP 1136.001 - SAM Backdating via Silent Regedit Import
description: Detects silent registry import via regedit /s used to manipulate SAM account metadata (e.g. backdating password timestamps to make accounts appear old and legitimate). A randomly named .reg file with /s suppresses all UI prompts. This is the final step in the CreateHiddenAccount toolkit's evasion chain.
